text: Fold state lives in App.tsx as `foldRest` (line 75), defaulting to true, and the FilterBar toggles it via `onFolded` (line 590). When a filter is active and has matches, App.tsx line 370 builds the graph with `foldTree(scope.graphRoot, scope.dim)`, and line 526 passes `collapseDim` to Zoom. In Zoom.tsx (around lines 198-209), each run of dimmed, non-matching children collapses into a `dim-run` button labelled "N filtered". Clicking it adds the run's id to `openRuns`, which reveals those children.
